name: @nodesify/astria
stderr:
Usage: astria [options] [command]

Turn any folder into a queryable knowledge graph

Options:
  -V, --version                              output the version number
  -h, --help                                 display help for command

Commands:
  run [options] <path>                       Run the full pipeline on a directory
  update [options] <path>                    Refresh the graph using its saved indexing policy
  watch [options] <path>                     Watch for file changes and auto-rebuild
  explain [options] <node>                   Explain a node and its connections
  query [options] <question>                 BFS/DFS graph traversal for a question
  path [options] <source> <target>           Find shortest path between two nodes
  map [options]                              Repo map: PageRank-ranked files with top symbols, within a token budget
  affected [options] <node>                  Show the blast radius of a node — everything impacted by changing it
  stats [options]                            Show graph statistics
  god-nodes [options]                        List the highest-degree hub nodes (CLI parity with the MCP god_nodes tool)
  communities [options]                      List communities with labels, size, cohesion, and modularity (CLI parity with the MCP list_communities tool)
  neighbors [options] <node>                 List a node's neighbors, optionally filtered by relation (CLI parity with the MCP get_neighbors tool)
  health [options]                           Code-health report: unreachable-symbol candidates, file cycles, hub concentration, staleness (heuristic score)
  risk [options]                             Blast radius of the current git diff: impacted symbols and communities, with a heuristic risk score for PRs
  export [options]                           Export graph to JSON, HTML, GraphML, SVG, Cypher (Neo4j), or FalkorDB Cypher
  callflow [options] <node>                  Mermaid call-flow diagram: what a node calls (or what calls it)
  cluster-only [options] <path>              Run cluster + analyze + report only (no extract/build)
  merge [options] <pathA> <pathB> <outPath>  Merge two graphs into a new output graph (cross-repo by default: ids namespaced per root; --same-repo shares ids and errors on conflicts)
  diff <pathA> <pathB>                       Compare two graphs and show differences
  history [options]                          Show recent query history
  mcp [options]                              Run an MCP server exposing the graph to AI agents — stdio by default, or HTTP with --http
  tree [options]                             Export a collapsible filesystem tree of all graph symbols (self-contained HTML)
  wiki [options]                             Export a Wikipedia-style markdown wiki (index.md + one article per community and god node)
  prs [options] [count]                      Map open pull requests onto the knowledge graph: CI state, review status, worktree mapping, ranked review queue, merge-order risk
  add [options] [url]                        Fetch a URL (arXiv paper, tweet, webpage, image, PDF) into ./raw, or save a transcript, and update the graph
  status [options]                           Check graph health, staleness, and build provenance (which astria and extraction rules built it)
  install [options]                          Install Astria integrations in this project, or explicitly for the user
  uninstall [options]                        Remove scoped integrations; data is kept unless separately selected for deletion
  doctor [options]                           Check installation, native runtime, integrations, permissions and graph compatibility without changing setup
  hook                                       Manage git hooks for auto-rebuild
  merge-driver                               Git merge driver for .astria/graph.json — union-merges parallel-branch graph commits instead of conflicting
